Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at

the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. EMD/ PBG exemptions, if needed are to be claimed along with necessary certificates/ by quoting necess ary exemption clauses with proof. 5. PBG validity should be Delivery period + Warranty period + Two months. Original PBG to be submitted within 15 days from the receipt of supply order. 6. Any queries, Contact Details- 080-25233105, 7389459793. 7. Submission copy of following documents is to be ensured. - (a) GST Registration (b) PAN details (c) Fina ncial Turnover and (d)Experience Certificate/ Necessary certification of quality/ Supply Orders from Govt. D epartments/ renowned firms/ PSUs. 8. The L1 vendor will be decided based on overall cost only. However, before signing the contract, vendor s are expected to give detailed breakdown for each of the supply and service to facilitate deductions again st any supplies/ services which are not completed. This is negotiable within the quoted amount. 9. In case of non-availability of the detailed breakdown, the Buyer’s decision will be considered as final and will be binding on the ‘Seller’. 10. Payment terms – 100% Payment after delivery, installation and commissioning. 11. Extension of Delivery Period (DP) is not generally granted. In case of extreme situation, the extension may be sought as per DPM 2025. 12. The SOW will be conducted as per tech details and same is to be confirmed in Tech Compliance Matrix. 13. If there is any mismatch found in GeM Catalogue specifications and Technic al specifications attached i n Bid Specific ATC by the buyer then Technical specifications attached by the buyer will be accepted as fin al. 14. Warranty- 03 Years post acceptance of product / service. 15. EMD-Forms: (If applicable) To be filled and submitted in the name of “Air Force Public Fund Accoun t SDI, AF”. 16. PBG: (If applicable): To be filled and submitted in the name of “Air Force Public Fund Account SDI, AF”. 21. Vendor to provide OEM Certification wherever applicable. 22. Following additional items to be provided with the board:- 22.1. Ground stand with wheel. 22.2. HDMI cable with 15m length.

22.3. Display cover. 22.4. Display film protector. 22.5. 10m long power cable. . 3. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 4. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 3 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.
